issue.title: R0015: Prevent Bash installer writes through an attacker-prepared staging tree
issue.body:
<!-- salah-widget-audit-20260907:SW-021 -->
# R0015: Prevent Bash installer writes through an attacker-prepared staging tree

**Repository-local identity:** `R0015` in `theislampill/salah_widget`; existing tracker [#21](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/21). The SW identifier is historical draft provenance.


Campaign draft alias: SW-021. Product defect; proposed priority P1, retaining SEC-002’s bounded unintended-overwrite witness. The Bash installer must create and use privately owned paths for every staged write. It must also retain the unpacked extension directory after exit, because Chromium’s manual “Load unpacked” path depends on that directory continuing to exist.

This is a repair to staging ownership and artifact lifetime. It is not a remote-code-execution finding, a Windows security claim, or authority to run an installer against real user data.

## Re-anchor and preserve the actual boundary

Main `fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624` and candidate `9d9c43649748555afbe09e3ca49bc47db2d7e7bb` had byte-identical `install.sh` in the retained witness: SHA256 `89d919e365846ec5e3b31a0ed4a41f95e3364659336c04ab1f066abcd1173e63`. The function extracted with LF text had SHA256 `e47e541250c0a6cd61840f0c82337507dd8a59703fd0e18c61ba3f7cd6efcde2`. Those bind historical copies; do not assume a future checkout or distributed file still matches.

```text
git --no-optional-locks rev-parse --show-toplevel
git --no-optional-locks remote get-url origin
git --no-optional-locks status --short --branch
git --no-optional-locks rev-parse HEAD
git --no-optional-locks diff fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624 HEAD -- install.sh README.md
```

Confirm the intended `theislampill/salah_widget` checkout and its guidance before editing. Preserve dirty/unrelated work. Stop and reconcile changed staging paths, write sites, cleanup or output return contracts. The candidate is comparison evidence, not a whole-branch adoption mandate.

Public owners: [predictable initialization](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/install.sh#L34-L37), [asset download/extraction/preset writes](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/install.sh#L282-L356), [manual extension and import consumers](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/install.sh#L359-L427), [terminal staged-path claim](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/install.sh#L494-L502), [README manual boundary](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/fd2972ba64225fe9d6848e92497e6d0ed20ea624/README.md#L62-L68), and [candidate installer](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/blob/9d9c43649748555afbe09e3ca49bc47db2d7e7bb/install.sh).

## Demonstrated incident and what remains unproved

The installer constructs `${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/salah-widget-installer`, then `mkdir -p` accepts a preexisting tree. It writes a predictable `presets/salah-widget.tablissng.json` with `curl -o`; configured content is subsequently read and rewritten at the same pathname. Neither operation checks whether that path is a symlink or whether its ancestors belong to this invocation.

The saved fixture prepared that preset pathname as a symlink to its own `fixture-victim.txt`, initially `unchanged sentinel\n`. It supplied harmless local JSON `{"fixture":"harmless","input":"#local=1"}` and hash `lat=24.47&lon=39.61&method=4`. The exact initialization and `download_preset()` followed the link, returned success, and left the victim as `{"fixture":"harmless","input":"#lat=24.47&lon=39.61&method=4"}`. `link-is-symlink=true` remained true. Both source copies exited 0.

This was actual fixture-file mutation under WSL Ubuntu on DrvFS, using local `file://` curl semantics. It did not involve a second UID, native Linux permission enforcement, native macOS, default `/tmp`, an actual browser profile, network access or a full wizard. The primitive is an installer-user-writable file overwrite. Cross-user exploitation depends on who can prepare/control the parent tree and when the installer uses it. Do not promote this evidence into arbitrary privileged overwrite, remote execution or a claim about PowerShell’s TEMP.

## Reproduce the RED safely from public inputs

Save this as `red-staging.py` in an authorized disposable directory. On a symlink-capable Linux/macOS fixture host, run `python3 red-staging.py /absolute/pinned/install.sh /absolute/authorized-fixture-parent`. It creates a new child under that parent, leaves it for inspection, and never executes the full wizard. Inspect the pinned source/extraction boundaries first; do not feed unknown installer text into this fixture.

```python
import hashlib, pathlib, subprocess, sys, tempfile
src = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text(encoding='utf-8')
parent = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[2]).resolve(strict=True)
if not parent.is_dir(): raise SystemExit('fixture parent must exist')
root = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='staging-red-', dir=str(parent)))
victim = root / 'fixture-victim.txt'
victim.write_bytes(b'unchanged sentinel\n')
data = root / 'download.json'
data.write_bytes(b'{"fixture":"harmless","input":"#local=1"}\n')
presets = root / 'salah-widget-installer' / 'presets'
presets.mkdir(parents=True)
link = presets / 'salah-widget.tablissng.json'
link.symlink_to(victim)
before = hashlib.sha256(victim.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
init = src[src.index('WORK_ROOT='):src.index('\nsay_section()')]
fn = src[src.index('download_preset() {'):src.index('\ninstall_tablissng() {')]
program = r'''set -Eeuo pipefail
TMPDIR="$1"
SALAH_WIDGET_PRESET_URL="file://$1/download.json"
SALAH_WIDGET_HASH='lat=24.47&lon=39.61&method=4'
DRY_RUN=0
ok(){ printf '[OK] %s\n' "$1" >&2; }
warn(){ printf '[WARN] %s\n' "$1" >&2; }
''' + init + '\n' + fn + '\ndownload_preset\n'
r = subprocess.run(['bash','--noprofile','--norc','-c',program,'fixture',str(root)],
                   text=True,capture_output=True)
print('fixture', root, 'exit', r.returncode)
print('stdout', r.stdout, 'stderr', r.stderr)
print('before', before, 'after', hashlib.sha256(victim.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
print('symlink', link.is_symlink(), 'victim', victim.read_text())
```

The pinned RED must show changed victim bytes, the replacement hash in JSON, and a still-existing symlink. The GREEN oracle is byte-identical sentinel with normal output successfully written elsewhere in the newly owned tree; rejecting the hostile old tree is also safe if no output was promised. This fixture is a historical-mechanism reproduction recipe, not a newly executed PASS. The repaired entry and all write consumers need separate integration controls below.

## Selected repair: fresh private ownership, explicit retention

**1. Establish ownership before the first effect.** Move eager initialization out of top level into a small staging initializer called only after platform/input/eligible-target checks and only in non-dry execution. Use `umask 077` and the host’s established `mktemp -d` facility. Fail closed on creation/check failure; never fall back to the old predictable shared tree. Initialize path variables as unset/empty and record ownership only after successful creation and verification, so failure cleanup cannot accidentally interpret an empty variable as a parent/root target.

Use two directories with different lifetimes: a fresh transient download root under the validated temporary parent, and a fresh retained bundle directly under the validated user home, for example the proposed template `$HOME/salah-widget-install.XXXXXXXX`. Keeping the retained bundle under the user’s home avoids the OS purging the only unpacked extension from a temporary directory. Place the preset, Firefox installation file and final Chromium unpacked directory in the retained bundle. ZIP acquisition and incomplete downloads can stay transient. The exact generated bundle path is printed and copied only after its contents pass validation.

**2. Guard parents and children, not just the final leaf.** On the platform already selected by the script, use the native `stat` form (GNU `stat -c` on Linux, BSD `stat -f` on macOS), `id -u`, Bash `-O` and `-L`, and physical `pwd -P` checks. Qualify their actual availability on the claimed hosts; no `realpath -m` or newer Bash dependency is assumed. Resolve and verify the retained home parent: it must be owned by the current UID, a directory, and not writable by group/other. Reject a symlink in the supplied ownership boundary or an untrusted writable ancestor that could rename that boundary. A temporary parent may instead be root-owned sticky `/tmp`; a custom TMPDIR must satisfy a documented trusted-parent rule, not just be nonempty. If those checks cannot establish ownership on an unusual mount, stop with a manual path explanation rather than weakening them.

The new roots must resolve to their freshly created paths, belong to the current UID and have mode 0700. Existing retained bundles and the old shared cache are not silently reused. Derive children only from fixed names or existing sanitized leaf names, reject empty/`.`/`..` components and separators, and verify an output’s physical parent is inside the recorded root before each write, extraction or cleanup. Use a path-component boundary, so `/safe/root-other` does not count as inside `/safe/root`. Reject any preexisting symlink/nonregular output and symlinked directory component before proceeding. An attacker with the same UID is outside what these checks can isolate; do not claim this is a substitute for OS privilege separation.

**3. Keep the write chain closed.** Route `download_preset`, `download_tablissng_asset` and `expand_chromium_asset` through those owned roots. Download to a fresh file in an owned directory, validate, then make the final artifact available to the caller. Preserve exact `SALAH_WIDGET_HASH` substitution and JSON parsing behavior; do not follow a caller-supplied path into arbitrary storage. For extraction, use a new empty child instead of `rm -rf` on a derived preexisting unpacked directory. Validate archive member paths for absolute paths/parent traversal and disallow links escaping the extraction root using the available extraction tool’s supported behavior; if the tool cannot provide that check, stop rather than calling a successful unzip confinement proof. This is the direct all-write consumer check for the staging invariant, not a new signing or update framework.

**4. Make the artifact lifetime honest.** The retained bundle survives normal exit, errors after staging, and restart. Print “keep this directory while the unpacked extension is installed” for Chromium. Preset/XPI removal is manual after import/install and optional; the script must not guess that pressing Enter means the browser no longer needs a file. Never put the retained bundle in an unconditional EXIT trap. Transient cleanup may remove only this invocation’s verified owned scratch root; if identity changed or the path is a link, leave it and report the exact partial state. Retaining an incomplete owned bundle with an explicit failure label is safer than deleting a directory a user may already have loaded.

No migration of old predictable caches is included. Cross-run reuse of that unverified state is retired. **Same-attempt cache contract:** initialize one verified `DOWNLOAD_ROOT` for the current installer attempt; repeated selection of the same artifact within that attempt finds the regular owned file already downloaded there, returns the same path and avoids another asset fetch. Do not allocate a new root on each helper call, since that would defeat legitimate within-attempt reuse. **Cross-run contract:** the next invocation creates a different private root and never treats a prior shared cache or retained manual bundle as a silently admitted download cache. User-facing retained bundles remain available for their documented lifetime. This is the concrete private-cache interface consumed by the neighboring stdout/path owner and finalized for parent JOIN below.

## Why the tempting smaller fixes are insufficient

`chmod 700` on an existing predictable path can follow or legitimize attacker-prepared state; it does not establish fresh ownership. Checking only `-L "$dest"` leaves symlinked ancestors. A unique temporary root plus unconditional cleanup prevents this overwrite but destroys the manual unpacked-install path on exit. Leaving all artifacts under `/tmp` documents a lifetime that the installer cannot preserve across system cleanup. Reusing old shared downloads “for convenience” reintroduces the trust boundary the repair removed.

The chosen design adds one bounded staging initializer and a confinement check with real callers at each write/cleanup site. It reuses shell tools already needed by this installer family. It does not create a global cache database, background cleaner, per-user service, manifest protocol or signature authority. If more elaborate archive authentication is requested, stop and obtain a separate owner decision rather than claiming it from safe staging.

## Final-tree matrix and native limits

| Case | GREEN oracle / negative control |
|---|---|
| Exact hostile old preset symlink vector | Victim hash unchanged; old symlink untouched; valid output lives only in a new owned bundle. |
| Parent symlink, wrong UID, group/world-writable retained parent, symlink output, `..` or prefix-lookalike path | Fail before writing/extracting/deleting the target. Own sentinels outside the new root remain byte-identical. |
| Ordinary local preset with configured hash | Valid JSON has exact configured `#lat=24.47&lon=39.61&method=4`; returned path is one regular file in the retained bundle. |
| ZIP with nested manifest; malformed ZIP; traversal/symlink member | Valid confined extraction returns an existing in-root manifest directory; unsafe input fails and cannot change an outside sentinel. |
| Two invocations; same valid asset twice within one invocation | Distinct roots across runs; no implicit old-cache adoption; within-run reuse returns the same owned path without duplicate asset fetch. |
| Exit after download, preset failure, extraction failure, interrupt | Scratch cleanup only when ownership still matches; retained/manual directory remains usable or explicitly partial; no broad deletion. |
| Complete manual bundle then script exits | In an authorized disposable consumer, returned unpacked directory and manifest still exist after exit and restart; no automatic retention claim from a printed pathname alone. |
| DRY_RUN=1 after integration | No creation, permission change, copy, download, extraction or cleanup in either root; preview prints placeholders, not existing-artifact claims. |
| Mutants: restore predictable root; follow link; delete retained bundle at EXIT | Respectively victim/confinement/lifetime controls fail. |

Run filesystem probes only beneath explicit disposable fixture parents. For the cross-user claim, use native Linux with distinct fixture UIDs and native permission semantics, and qualify intended macOS/Bash behavior separately. WSL/DrvFS is retained primitive evidence, not the final native permission gate. Real browser loading requires separate authorization and disposable profiles; if not performed, label retained-path checks as filesystem lifetime proof only.

## Interfaces, rollback and closure

[R0016](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/22) has the accepted interface dependency on this owner and shares staging/preset/unpacked lifetimes; agree that initializer and cleanup are unreachable in dry-run. [R0013](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/19) owns stdout path bytes and same-attempt cached-path consumers. **Private-cache interface finalized for parent JOIN:** this owner supplies the newly created, verified root once per attempt and rejects automatic cross-run admission; the path owner proves first/second-call byte identity, stderr diagnostics and zero repeat asset fetch within that same root. Path creation/lifetime inside `download_tablissng_asset` is the shared hunk; stdout format remains with the path owner. The parent will reconcile SW-021→SW-019 and that collision in graph/pair/partition metadata. This body does not silently rewrite the accepted 25 edges or 496 pair dispositions, and the interface does not require waiting for the whole upstream issue to close. Shared installer writes and README lifetime text need one integrator.

IMPLEMENTAUDIT R001D applies to the real retained-path instructions, script usage and README. Preserve manual import, dashboard replacement warning, preset 325×530 dimensions/geolocation scope, encoded configuration and Bash 3.2. PowerShell staging is outside this witness. Rollback may move to another verified private path or retain safe bundles; it must never restore writes through the predictable shared tree. Never recursively delete an unverified old path or preexisting user artifact during migration or rollback.

DONE requires the final integrated tree’s sentinel, ownership, confinement, lifetime and dry-run controls, the actual native-host evidence claimed, independent exact-tree security review, and an evidence comment recording exact commit, fixture inputs/results and remaining mount/host limitations. Any public installer claim additionally needs authorized distributed-byte/instruction readback. Use non-closing `Implements #21` PR wording and manual closure after evidence. Publishing the work order establishes neither a repaired installer nor a successful extension installation.

Methodology references (separate repository, not Salah work owners): [R001D in IMPLEMENTAUDIT](https://github.com/theislampill/IMPLEMENTAUDIT.md/issues/155).

Identity provenance: first repository-local allocation batch; existing GitHub object order was used to assign distinct monotonic hex-4 IDs. Closed/held IDs are not reused. Issue number is not implementation priority.
